next_step: Closed-lost. Monitor regulatory window; re-open if security scope tightens or vendor consolidation needed.
notes:
Overview: Skyline Aegis is a midwestern fintech (payments + fraud detection) evaluating inference platforms for customer support automation and doc search across regulated data. High security bar: must support KMS, SSO, strict retention & residency. POC was scoped for reranking+support-agent; throughput target ~150 rps, 95th pct latency <250ms for chat workloads.

Timeline / Recent activity:
- 2024-09-12: Intro call (Maya + Daniel). Customer asked for private deployment options, on-prem baseline.
- 2024-09-20: Demo of Redwood Dedicated (A/B with smaller model). SE live demo; positive on batching & observability.
- 2024-10-03: Shared security pack; security team requested SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details (ticket SEC-4412 opened).
- 2024-10-18: POC kickoff (2-week): small reranking job + chat agent on dedicated dev pool. Fireflies: FF-2024-11-08-7851.
- 2024-11-05: Security review summary: SRE liked runtime but SecurOps preferred vendor with widely recognized compliance posture.
- 2024-11-18: Procurement sync; CFO flagged Q4 hiring/budget freeze. Internal champion (Head of AI Ops) left in org reorg, paused decision.
- 2024-11-28: Final call — Skyline verbally committed to using OpenAI direct APIs for initial rollout citing speed to production, brand trust, and simpler billing. Redwood closed-lost.

Customer quotes / signals:
- "We need the path of least resistance to ship first release — brand familiarity matters."
- Security: "We can revisit if we need private deployment later, but initial launch will be hosted."

Why lost:
- Decision driven by simplicity and brand comfort (OpenAI/Anthropic). Procurement favored single-vendor contract with known public APIs.
- Budget freeze in Q4 removed flexibility for Dedicated/Private upfront spend.
- No internal champion after reorg — procurement deprioritized platform migration.

What to keep for follow-up:
- Monitor regulatory/regional requirements that force on-prem/VPC (6–9 month horizon).
- Keep security artifacts up-to-date (SOC2 mapping, KMS integration guide).
- Target re-engage if they hit rate limits/cost pain with OpenAI or need private deployment for residency.

Next outreach plan (internal):
- Nurture cadence: 90-day check-in from Maya to CISO + Head of Platform. Short email with updated private deployment checklist and case studies.
- If OpenAI usage spikes or cost issues appear, offer small pilot migration plan and migration cost model.
